name: Icons
description: Icons on files and folders: shown in the sidebar, tabs, next to a note's first heading and links, set from the context menu, kept when you rename or move; Iconize icons show with no setup (read-only), and :shortcodes render inline.

memory.note: One small file per vault (.writer/icons.json) and one read of Iconize's data when a workspace opens or either file changes; the picker and icon sets load when first used. The Rust half (the commands and the writer icon commands) takes effect at the next launch.
